title: Concept: World-writable permissions granted in a shell script in shell — review required
description: In shell, chmod grants write permission to everyone. World-writable files break the ownership boundary the rest of the system relies on, and when the target is read by a privileged process it becomes a route from an unprivileged account to that privilege. The mode is often added to silence a permission error during deployment.
risk: Local privilege escalation through a shared writable path; MEDIUM severity.
